description.value: Happy Cow Ice Cream is a family-owned, scratch-made ice cream shop in Fernie, BC, handcrafting small-batch flavours using real ingredients — organic cocoa, fresh fruit, local coffee, and homemade mix-ins with no artificial additives. The shop offers scoops, waffle cones, popsicles, ice cream sandwiches built on housemade cookies, and take-home pints and tubs. Customer reviews note outdoor seating and a dog-friendly setup.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at happycowicecream.ca is fully accessible and confirms an active scoop shop in Fernie, BC. A customer review mentions 'Seating outside and water for the puppers,' confirming outdoor seating; no explicit bike rack or water refill for cyclists is mentioned. The website confirms dairy-free (mango sorbet), gluten-free options (GF crumble, GF graham crackers), and take-home pints/popsicles as takeout-style products.
concerns: No address or phone number in OSM record; none could be confirmed from website content.
OSM record has no osm_id or tags — appears to be a manual addition with minimal OSM data.

enrichment_extras.notes: Dog-friendly outdoor seating confirmed by customer review ('water for the puppers'). Shop also operates a mobile scooping trailer and ice cream van for events.
